ABSENCE REPORTING LINE: 01249 818100
Exciting Time
Thank you for taking the time to view the Kingsbury Green Academy website. This is a tremendously exciting time for everyone associated with the school, as we go from strength to strength as part of the outstanding Ascend Learning Trust.
At Kingsbury Green Academy, we believe in the power of education to change young people’s lives and we aim to be inclusive and cater for the needs of all our students. We will achieve this with inspirational teaching, excellent pastoral care and a wide range of extra-curricular activities that will enable our students to become well-rounded, confident young people who have an impact on the world.
Excellence
Excellence is a golden thread that runs throughout the Ascend Learning Trust. Our mission statement, “Achieving Excellence Together”, drives this commitment and informs every part of our day to day practice so that students achieve the best standards possible.
We celebrate achievement in all its forms and aim to help your child define what excellence looks like for them on a personal level. We believe that this can only be done together in partnership, bringing together the combined expertise of the Trust, you as parents and of course the desire of our students to achieve wonderful outcomes.
We will work hard to ensure that our students feel a strong sense of belonging both to the school and to the local community and are proud to be Kingsbury Green Academy students and proud to be a part of the wider Calne area community.
Nicola Bull
Headteacher

pageCache.text:
ABSENCE REPORTING LINE: 01249 818100
Realising Potential
The aim of the support department is for each pupil to realise his or her potential within an enriched, inclusive community.
The SENCO, Miss Giddings along with the support team are responsible for the day to day implementation of the SEND policy.
We will coordinate the extra support and provision for pupils with a range of specialist needs.
We work closely with teaching staff to ensure that they have access to personalised strategies and can build their knowledge of SEND to enable those with specific needs to flourish, alongside their peers.
Working With Parents
An integral part of our department is working with parents and outside agencies.
We thrive on building and sustaining a positive working relationship with parents of pupils with SEND as this is known to enable them to achieve academic success.
We warmly welcome parental involvement throughout their child’s time at school.If you would like to know more about the support that your child will receive as a Kingsbury Green Academy student, please contact Miss Giddings, SENCO sgiddings@kga.ascendlearningtrust.org.uk

Governing Body Structure
Kingsbury Green Academy (formerly The John Bentley School) joined Ascend Learning Trust (formerly Royal Wootton Bassett Academy Trust) on 1st April 2019. The academy has a Local Governing Body which meets six times a year. There are no sub-committees.
The Local Governing Body is a committee which meets to monitor, evaluate and review the Academy Improvement Plan, ensuring clear links from the self-evaluation process.
The responsibilities of the Local Governing Body are as follows:
Trust governance
Statutory and regulatory compliance
Student outcomes
Community engagement
School development
Governing Body Structure
The Local Governing Body comprises up to twelve members including:
Each LGB shall have a Chair and a Vice-Chair.
The length of service of all Local Governors and the Clerk to the LGB shall be four years. Subject to remaining eligible to be a Local Governor, any Local Governor may be reappointed or re-elected at the end of his or her term.
the Head teacher of the Academy;
Such other members as the Trustees decide.
Ascend Learning Trust
Ascend Learning Trust has strategic responsibilities which include achieving high level educational performance in all of its Academies, owning all assets, employing all staff, and receiving all funding from the Education Funding Agency to allocate budgets to each Academy in Ascend Learning Trust, whilst providing effective and efficient corporate services which offer value for money.
Ascend Learning Trust operates through a governance structure, which includes the Ascend Learning Trust Board of Trustees, supported by a Finance Committee, Standards Committee and Academy Attainment Committee identified below. Each Committee has its own Terms of Reference. Academy Local Governing Bodies feed into the governance structure.

Curriculum Statement
The Kingsbury Green Academy curriculum will provide all learners with a depth of knowledge and a rich understanding of a broad range of subjects.
The curriculum is a coherent spiral model curriculum, which builds through a 7-year learning journey to outstanding levels of achievement for all pupils.
Central to the design of the KGA curriculum is a breadth of experience enhanced through dedicated time for enrichment and personal development, underpinned by the 5 KGA values of courage, confidence, creativity, conscientiousness and consideration for others.
Note: If you would like further information about the curriculum, please contact the school office or the relevant subject leader.
Key Stages
At Key Stage 3 all students will study:
English, Maths, Science, Modern Foreign Languages, PE, Art, Music, Technology, IT, Dance, Geography, History, RE and PSHE. At Key Stage 4 the majority of students follow courses that lead to eight GCSEs and alongside the core subjects, choices here include Sport, Engineering, Film Studies, Hospitality & Catering, Business, German, Psychology and more. At Post 16 we offer many courses in our Sixth Form and many of our students then go on to Higher Education at establishments all across the country.

EXTRA-CURRICULAR / KGA+
"The Kingsbury Green Academy extra-curricular programme is the most comprehensive of its kind in Wiltshire."
Enriching the lives of our students through KGA+
Every teacher contributes at least one KGA+ session per week, meaning we can offer our students a huge range of activities that will enrich their school experience. The list of clubs is extensive and incorporates a diverse range of opportunities from Book Club to Allotment Club to our LGBTQ+ Group. There are some fantastic creative activities on offer, including Dance Club, Concert Band and Photography Club. Sports enthusiasts are equally well represented with football, netball and rugby clubs all thriving, among many others. Whatever your interests, there is sure to be something for you on the ‘KG Club’ programme.

Careers Partnerships
We are working in partnership with Skills Builder and their Universal Framework to support our pupils in the development of their essential skills for life.
We work closely with Careerpilot which provides careers information and tools for 11-19 year olds, all in one place. All our students have a Careerpilot account.
The Wessex Inspiration Network (WIN) Programme
WIN (Wessex Inspiration Network) is one of 29 regional partnerships within the Uni Connect Programme which aims to increase social mobility by raising awareness of Higher Education (HE) opportunities and progression pathways for young people, particularly those from disadvantaged backgrounds.
We work closely with our WIN Higher Education Adviser, empowering our students to overcome barriers and explore their future options and routes into education.
Students, parents/carers and teachers can find fantastic careers support and advice on the WIN website and can read about our WIN HE Adviser here.

Enterprise Coordinators are trained professionals who work with clusters of 20 schools and colleges to build careers plans and make connections to local and national employers.

Employers and Education Providers
Thank you to all the employers and education providers who already support Kingsbury Green Academy. We really appreciate the time and effort that you give to our school and our students benefit greatly from your contribution.
We always welcome volunteers and opportunities and support from the local business and education community.
If you are interested in getting involved or working with our students there are numerous opportunities for you to do so throughout the year. You can register your interest in the various areas of the careers programme via the Opportunities form.
Please also refer to the Provider Access Statement and contact Catherine Young, Careers Leader at careers@kga.ascendlearningtrust.org.uk if you would like to find out more.
Before a visit to Kingsbury Green Academy to work with our pupils, you will need to read our SAFEGUARDING GUIDE FOR VISITORS.
If you are hosting one of our pupils for Work Experience, you will need to read our KGA Work Experience Information for Employers 25-26. Here is also a copy of the Barclay’s Life Skills Work Experience Log that we will be asking our pupils to complete during their placement with you.
We look forward to hearing from you.

Labour Market Information (LMI)
Get access to LMI quickly and easily with the Skillsometer and Careerometer.
Skillsometer can help you discover what jobs you might like to do in the future.
1. If you are using a mobile phone, turn it landscape to see the full view of the Skillsometer
2. You are presented with a series of statements - select the emoji that shows how you feel about each statement.
3. Read about the suggested jobs that link to what you most enjoy doing and discover some headline UK data.
Careerometer can be used to explore and compare key information about occupations, help you learn about different occupations and identify potential careers. It provides access to a selection of UK headline data relating to pay, weekly hours of work and future employment prospects for different occupations, as well as description of the occupation.
Type in the title of the job you are interested in - the widget provides a series of options from which you can select the most relevant to you.
Look up another two* occupations (*only 2 in total can be viewed on mobile phone) and compare. You can also select ‘display the UK average’ and compare the information with the occupation you have selected.
IF VIEWING ON A MOBILE phone, turn it landscape to compare occupations side by side.
